focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: Editing Matrices Without Losing Track of Their Shape
utility_title: CSV Profile: A First-Pass Data Quality Check
utility_use_case: A researcher receives instrument-exported measurements and wants to know whether the file has blank cells, inconsistent row widths, or plausible numeric ranges before plotting or fitting a model. Running `csv-profile` provides a reproducible structural and descriptive checkpoint. The researcher can then investigate flagged rows and define any exclusion or correction rule separately, preserving the original file and avoiding unsupported statistical conclusions.
